_about: Starting points for the FDOP Workbench taken from the current signed FDOPs. Values here win over the 2026 thresholds sheet when the Workbench opens an FDRA; users can change everything from there. Optional "weights": {stationId: weight} gives a weighted SIG (FDOP SIG tables); stations without a weight count 1.

BLM-NOD-260.source: BLM CA-NOD Fire Danger Operating Plan 2017 (draft) — no FDOP breakpoints
BLM-NOD-260.notes: CA-NOD FDOP 2017 is a draft: the decision summary table and staffing/dispatch breakpoints were never filled in. FDRA 265 Eagle Lake FO (SIG Blue Door 40725, Bull Flat 40728, Buffalo Creek 260113 NV, Horse Lake 40727, Ravendale 40714, Hidden Valley 40732) and FDRA 260 Applegate FO/Surprise (Barrel Springs 260111 NV, Juniper Creek 40308, Juniper Springs 260112 NV, Fox Mtn 260110 NV, Surprise Valley 43690). Plan recommends one SIG of all 11 stations for both FDRAs (one daily BI/dispatch level for NOD, matching SIFC practice) — used here. Plan uses BLM 80th/95th BI climatological breakpoints on NFDRS 1978 fuel model T: 265 70.0/85.6, 260 70.75/87.6, all 69.3/85.8 (1997–2016) — not comparable with NFDRS 2016; fuel model W (grass-shrub, the NFDRS 2016 equivalent of T) is used, with BLM 80th/95th percentiles computed from FEMS. Hidden Valley has only ~5 years of data. FDRA polygons are the CA part only (both FDRAs extend into Nevada); BLM-owned land (NIFC Jurisdictional Units) split at the Modoc/Lassen county line.
